cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The trousers hold no office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.
